license_required.quote: No person shall engage in bail bond business without first having been licensed as provided in this chapter.

issuing_authority.value: Professional Bail Bond Company and Professional Bail Bondsman Licensing Board
issuing_authority.quote: There is hereby created the Professional Bail Bond Company and Professional Bail Bondsman Licensing Board.

name.value: Professional Bail Bond Company and Professional Bail Bondsman Licensing Board
name.quote: There is hereby created the Professional Bail Bond Company and Professional Bail Bondsman Licensing Board.

type.quote: The board shall have the authority and responsibility to administer and enforce the provisions of this chapter relating to licensing and regulation of professional bail bond companies and professional bail bondsmen.

moral_character_required.quote: Provide other proof as the board may require that he or she is competent, trustworthy, financially responsible, and of good personal and business reputation

required.quote: Each applicant for an initial bail bondsman license who satisfactorily completes the examination and meets the other qualifications and requirements prescribed by law, including the completion of a minimum of eight (8) hours of education in subjects pertaining to the authority and responsibilities of a bail bondsman

experience_source.quote: Each applicant for an initial bail bondsman license who satisfactorily completes the examination and meets the other qualifications and requirements prescribed by law, including the completion of a minimum of eight (8) hours of education in subjects pertaining to the authority and responsibilities of a bail bondsman

exams.name: Written examination for professional bail bondsman license
exams.notes: Prepared by the board and appropriate to the transaction of bail bond business. Exam permit valid 90 days. Reexamination available with 8-week waiting period after two failures.
exams.quote: the Professional Bail Bond Company and Professional Bail Bondsman Licensing Board shall require every individual to submit to, and to pass to the satisfaction of the board, a written examination to be prepared by the board and appropriate to the transaction of bail bond business.

interval_years.quote: Every license issued pursuant to this chapter shall be for a term expiring on December 31 following the date of its issuance, and it may be renewed for the ensuing calendar year upon the filing of a renewal application.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Each professional bail bondsman shall pay a fee of one hundred dollars ($100) for renewal of the license

required.quote: Each person licensed as a professional bail bondsman shall annually complete not less than six (6) hours of continuing education in subjects relating to the authority and responsibilities of a bail bondsman as a condition of renewing his or her license.

hours_per_period.quote: annually complete not less than six (6) hours of continuing education

period_years.quote: Each person licensed as a professional bail bondsman shall annually complete not less than six (6) hours of continuing education

available.quote: An occupational licensing entity shall by rule adopt the least restrictive requirements for an occupational license for an individual who: (1) Demonstrates that he or she: (A) Holds an occupational license that is substantially similar to practice in the field of his or her occupation or profession in another state, territory, or district of the United States

requirements.value: Board must adopt rules for reciprocity or licensure by endorsement for out-of-state licensees holding a substantially similar license in good standing.
requirements.quote: An occupational licensing entity shall comply with the requirements under subsection (c) of this section by adopting the least restrictive rule that allows for reciprocity or licensure by endorsement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any provision of the chapter or any lawful rule or order of the board, or convicted of a listed felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any provision of or any obligation imposed by this chapter or any lawful rule or order of the board or has been convicted of a felony listed under § 17-3-102

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made a material misstatement in the application for license, renewal, or accompanying financial statement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Made a material misstatement in the application for license, in the application for renewal license, or in the financial statement which accompanies the application or renewal application for license as a professional bail bond company

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed fraudulent or dishonest acts or practices or demonstrated incompetency or untrustworthiness.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed any fraudulent or dishonest acts or practices or demonstrated incompetency or untrustworthiness to act as a licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charged or received premium or compensation in excess of that permitted by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Charged or received, as premium or compensation for the making of any deposit or bail bond, any sum in excess of that permitted by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Required as a condition of executing a bail bond that the principal engage the services of a specified attorney.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Required as a condition of executing a bail bond that the principal agree to engage the services of a specified attorney

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signed, executed, or issued bonds with endorsements in blank, or prepared or issued fraudulent or forged bonds or power of attorney.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signed, executed, or issued bonds with endorsements in blank, or prepared or issued fraudulent or forged bonds or power of attorney

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to account for and pay premiums held in a fiduciary capacity to the bail bond company or other person entitled thereto.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed in the applicable regular course of business to account for and to pay premiums held by the licensee in a fiduciary capacity to the professional bail bond company or other person entitled thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with provisions of state law or board rules for which the license could have been refused.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with the provisions of the laws of this state, or rule or order of the board for which issuance of the license could have been refused had it then existed and been known to the board.

definition_quote.value: "Professional bail bondsman" means an individual who is a resident of this state and who acts through authority of a professional bail bond company in pledging a bail bond as security in a judicial proceeding.
definition_quote.quote: "Professional bail bondsman" means an individual who is a resident of this state and who acts through authority of a professional bail bond company in pledging a bail bond as security in a judicial proceeding.

value: pledging a bail bond as security in a judicial proceeding
methods_authorized.quote: acts through authority of a professional bail bond company in pledging a bail bond as security in a judicial proceeding

agent_type_tiers.quote: "Licensee" means a professional bail bond company or a professional bail bondsman

power_of_attorney_required.quote: A professional bail bondsman shall not execute, issue, or deliver an appearance bond in this state without holding a valid appointment from a professional bail bond company and without attaching to the appearance bond an executed and numbered power of attorney referencing the professional bail bond company.

premium_rate_percentage.quote: the premium or compensation for giving bond or depositing money or property as bail on any bond shall be ten percent (10%), except that the amount may be rounded up to the nearest five-dollar amount.

minimum_premium_amount.quote: The minimum compensation for giving bond or depositing money or property as bail on any bond shall be not less than fifty dollars ($50.00).

premium_financing_allowed.quote: The premium or compensation under subdivision (a)(1) of this section shall be deposited in full prior to release. In no event shall all or a portion of the premium or compensation under subdivision (a)(1) of this section be deposited after release.

collateral_receipt_required.quote: When a licensee accepts collateral, he or she shall give a prenumbered written receipt for it, and this receipt shall give in detail a full account of the collateral received.

value: Soliciting business or advertising in or about any place where prisoners are confined
Soliciting business or advertising in or about any court

Entering a police station, jail, sheriff's office, or other place where persons in custody are detained for the purpose of obtaining employment without having been previously called by a detained person or authorized representative
solicitation_restrictions.quote: Solicit business or advertise for business in or about any place where prisoners are confined or in or about any court

attorney_referral_prohibited.quote: Require as a condition of his or her executing a bail bond that the principal agree to engage the services of a specified attorney

rebate_and_kickback_prohibition.quote: Pay a fee or rebate or give or promise anything of value to: (A) A jailer, police officer, peace officer, committing magistrate, or any other person who has power to arrest or to hold in custody; or (B) Any public official or public employee in order to secure a settlement, compromise, remission, or reduction of the amount of any bail bond or estreatment thereof

security_deposit_required_for_company.quote: An applicant for a professional bail bond company license shall file with the Professional Bail Bond Company and Professional Bail Bondsman Licensing Board an irrevocable letter of credit from an Arkansas chartered bank or a federally chartered bank in Arkansas or a certificate of deposit.

security_deposit_minimum_amount.value: $250,000 for companies initially licensed on or after July 1, 2009; $100,000 for companies initially licensed after July 1, 1989; $25,000 for companies initially licensed on or before July 1, 1989
security_deposit_minimum_amount.quote: The minimum amount for a professional bail bond company initially licensed on or after July 1, 2009, shall be two hundred fifty thousand dollars ($250,000).

unpaid_forfeiture_judgment_limit.quote: There shall be an initial one hundred thousand dollars ($100,000) limit on active unpaid bond forfeiture judgments for each bail bonding company.

quarterly_bond_reporting_required.quote: Each professional bail bond company shall file a bail bond report quarterly with the board.

bond_register_required.quote: Bail bonds shall be written on numbered forms. The Professional Bail Bond Company and Professional Bail Bondsman Licensing Board shall assign numbers for forms to professional bail bond companies and shall prescribe the method of affixing the numbers to the forms.

statewide_registry_of_licensees.quote: The board shall maintain a complete record of registrations, revocations, and suspensions, and the record shall be available to the sheriff and county clerk of each county of the state.

residency_requirement.quote: "Professional bail bondsman" means an individual who is a resident of this state

citizenship_or_work_authorization_requir.quote: An occupational or professional licensing entity shall grant an occupational or professional license under this section to an individual who fulfills the requirements to practice an occupation or profession in this state and is a person who holds a Federal Form I-766 United States Citizenship and Immigration Services-issued Employment Authorization Document

disqualifying_criminal_offenses.quote: An individual is not eligible to receive or hold a license issued by a licensing entity if that individual has pleaded guilty or nolo contendere to or been found guilty of any of the following offenses
disqualifying_criminal_offenses.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 3 - OCCUPATIONAL CRIMINAL BACKGROUND CHECKS (§§ 17-3]

prelicense_education_hours.quote: completion of a minimum of eight (8) hours of education in subjects pertaining to the authority and responsibilities of a bail bondsman and a review of the laws and rules relating thereto

continuing_education_hours_per_period.quote: annually complete not less than six (6) hours of continuing education in subjects relating to the authority and responsibilities of a bail bondsman as a condition of renewing his or her license.

continuing_education_period_years.quote: Each person licensed as a professional bail bondsman shall annually complete not less than six (6) hours of continuing education

continuing_education_exemption_for_senio.quote: Any licensed professional bail bondsman who is sixty-five (65) years of age or older and who has been licensed as a bail bondsman for fifteen (15) years or more shall be exempt from both the education and continuing education requirements

bail_bond_agency_license_separate_from_a.quote: Every applicant for a professional bail bondsman license or a professional bail bond company license shall apply on forms furnished by the Professional Bail Bond Company and Professional Bail Bondsman Licensing Board.

agency_ownership_experience_requirement.quote: Has at least one (1) owner or partner that has been licensed for at least two (2) years during the last three (3) years by the State of Arkansas as a professional bail bondsman.
